description: Search the CMS NPI Registry for US healthcare providers by name, state, specialty, or organization, or look up one or many NPI numbers.

addressPurpose.description: Choose whether city/state/ZIP filters apply to the practice (LOCATION) or mailing address. Leave blank to match either.
addressPurpose.title: Address to match location filters against

city.description: Filter results to providers in this city.
city.title: City

enumerationType.description: Filter by provider type. NPI-1 = individual providers, NPI-2 = organizations. Leave blank for all.
enumerationType.title: Enumeration type (NPI type)

exhaustiveSearch.description: The registry returns at most 1,200 records per search. Turn this on to split a broad query by state and provider type, merge the slices and remove duplicates. Slower and may use many requests; leave off for normal searches.
exhaustiveSearch.title: Get results past the registry's 1,200 cap

firstName.description: Provider first name. Supports a trailing wildcard, e.g. Rob* (modes: searchProviders, searchBySpecialty).
firstName.title: First name

lastName.description: Provider last name. Supports a trailing wildcard, e.g. Smit* (modes: searchProviders, searchBySpecialty).
lastName.title: Last name

maxItems.description: Maximum number of provider records to return. Without exhaustiveSearch the registry caps a single search at 1,200.
maxItems.title: Max items

mode.description: What to search in the NPI Registry.
enumTitles: Look up one or more NPI numbers
mode.title: Mode

npiNumber.description: A 10-digit National Provider Identifier. Comma-separated values are accepted for a small batch.
npiNumber.title: NPI number (mode=lookupByNPI)

npiNumbers.description: One or more 10-digit NPIs to resolve in a single run (up to 200). Combined with npiNumber when both are supplied.
npiNumbers.title: NPI numbers for bulk lookup (mode=lookupByNPI)

organizationName.description: Organization or group name (mode=searchByOrganization). Supports a trailing wildcard, e.g. Mayo*.
organizationName.title: Organization name

postalCode.description: Filter results by 5-digit US ZIP code.
postalCode.title: Postal code (ZIP)

specialtyDescription.description: Taxonomy or specialty text, e.g. 'Internal Medicine', 'Family Practice', 'Cardiology'. Partial matches and a trailing wildcard (*) are supported.
specialtyDescription.title: Specialty description

state.description: US state or territory abbreviation to filter providers.
state.title: State

useFirstNameAlias.description: When on, a first-name search also matches the provider's registered nickname or former first name (for example Bob for Robert).
useFirstNameAlias.title: Also match nickname aliases

title: NPI Registry Scraper Input
